properties.description: Standalone shell script that archives a model deploy bundle directory into a timestamped tar.gz under outputs/exports/
Launcher script for Pi05BridgeNode: constructs PYTHONPATH from project source dirs and runs python -m pi05.deploy.cli.bridge_ros with deploy config
Launcher script for CommandMuxNode: constructs PYTHONPATH from project source dirs and runs python -m pi05.deploy.cli.command_mux_ros with deploy config
Launcher script for Pi05VlaDeployNode: constructs PYTHONPATH from project source dirs and runs python -m pi05.deploy.cli.deploy_ros with deploy config (overridable via CLI arg)
Common code block shared by the 3 launch scripts that builds PYTHONPATH from common/src, train/src, deploy/src, and probes for third_party/lerobot/src
Common code structure shared by the 3 launch scripts: resolve CONFIG_PATH (with override), log the launch message, and invoke the python -m module with --config flag
Python CLI entry point for the ROS bridge node (Pi05BridgeNode). Called by run_bridge.sh via python -m.
Python CLI entry point for the command multiplexer node (CommandMuxNode). Called by run_command_mux.sh via python -m.
Python CLI entry point for the main VLA deploy node (Pi05VlaDeployNode). Called by run_inference.sh via python -m.
Central YAML configuration for Pi0.5 deployment: bundle path, safety limits, topic mappings, camera config, joint limits. Consumed by all 3 launch scripts.

Model deploy bundle directory containing adapter weights, normalizer stats, manifest, and tactile preprocess scripts. Produced by export_policy.sh (train/scripts), consumed by the deployment runtime, and archived by package_model.sh.

Train-side dataset schema sample defining the standard observation/action feature layout for PI0.5: 3 RGB cameras (top, left_wrist, right_wrist) at 224x224, state=26D, action=14D, chunk_size=30, fps=60

Full LoRA fine-tuning configuration for right-hand pour-water-cup task. Defines LoRA hyperparams (rank=32, alpha=64, dropout=0.05, 10 target modules), training params (batch=2, lr=1e-4, 6 epochs, bf16), 3 cameras, and logging setup

VTLA (Vision-Tactile-Language-Action) variant LoRA fine-tuning config. Extends the 3-camera layout with left_tactile and right_tactile cameras (5 total). Same LoRA and training hyperparams as lora.yaml, targets lerobot_octopus_v3_vtla dataset
Minimal experiment configuration template with experiment metadata (name, task), standard output paths (dataset, checkpoints, exports, logs), and launch settings (device, mixed_precision, resume)

Standard train-side dataset feature schema: observation.images.{top,left_wrist,right_wrist} (224x224x3 uint8), observation.state (26D float32), action (14D float32). chunk_size=30, fps=60. Used by all training configs and shared with deploy-side normalizer.
Standard LoRA configuration shared across fine-tuning variants: rank=32, alpha=64, dropout=0.05. Used by both lora.yaml and lora_vtla_stage1.yaml.

10 LoRA target modules covering all attention projections (q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj, out_proj), action expert head (action_in_proj, action_out_proj), time MLP (time_mlp_in, time_mlp_out), and generic linear layers.

Standard training hyperparameters: batch_size=2, lr=1e-4, epochs=6, gradient_accumulation_steps=8, warmup_steps=500, max_steps_per_epoch=null, seed=42, grad_clip_norm=1.0, mixed_precision=bf16, checkpoint_freq_epochs=1. Budget ~3k-6k steps, ~2 days on single GPU.

Model configuration: chunk_size=30, n_action_steps=30, state_dim=26, action_dim=14, max_action_dim=14 (forcing PI0.5 to use 14D instead of default 32D padding), pretrained_path='lerobot/pi05_base', train_expert_only=false.

Logging setup: wandb project=pi05, output_dir=../../outputs/checkpoints, export_dir=../../outputs/exports, tensorboard under ../../outputs/logs/tensorboard, auto-launch on localhost:6006, log_freq=200.

Standard 3-camera observation layout: top (overhead/scene view), left_wrist (egocentric left gripper), right_wrist (egocentric right gripper). Each 224x224x3 RGB. Used by data.yaml, lora.yaml, and shared as base for VTLA variant.

VTLA variant camera layout extending the 3-camera setup with left_tactile and right_tactile image inputs (224x224x3). Used by lora_vtla_stage1.yaml for the Octopus robot with Inspire Hand tactile sensors.

Enforced constraint: action always 14D regardless of state dimension expansion. Explicitly documented in data.yaml line 28 comment. model config max_action_dim=14 prevents PI0.5 from using 32D default padding.
State dimension 26 is derived as 14 (joint positions) + 2x6 (end-effector poses: x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw for left and right arms). Documented in lora.yaml line 27 comment.

Minimal experiment configuration template defining experiment name/notes/task, standard output paths (dataset, checkpoints, exports, logs), and launch settings (device=cuda, mixed_precision=bf16, resume support). Entry points left blank for CLI override.

nodes.name: export_policy.sh
nodes.docString: Shell script that exports a PI0.5 deploy bundle from a finished training run. Sets up PYTHONPATH (common/src, train/src, deploy/src, third_party/lerobot/src), then invokes `python -m pi05.train.cli.export_bundle --config train/config/lora.yaml`. Supports env overrides for RUN_DIR, ADAPTER_DIR, OUTPUT_DIR, and OVERWRITE.

nodes.name: prepare_dataset.sh
nodes.docString: Shell script that wraps tools/mcap_to_lerobot_v3.py to convert ROS2 MCAP recordings into LeRobot v3 datasets. Supports two modes: 'mcap' (single file) and 'mcap-dir' (directory). Discovers the converter script via a 3-tier path search. Configurable via env vars OUT_DIR, REPO_ID, TASK_NAME, FPS, and CONVERTER_SCRIPT.

nodes.name: smoke_test.py
nodes.docString: End-to-end smoke test for the Pi0.5 LoRA training stack. Validates: (1) model build with LoRA adapters, (2) mock LeRobot-style batch creation, (3) forward pass with finite loss, (4) backward pass with non-zero LoRA gradients. Falls back to synthetic language tokens if the official LeRobot PI0.5 preprocessor is unavailable.

nodes.name: test_dataloader.py
nodes.docString: Sanity-check script for the Pi0.5 LeRobot dataloader. Loads one batch from a real dataset, configures Pi05LeRobotDataset with state/action normalizers, and prints tensor shapes, dtypes, and value ranges for cameras, 26D state, and 14D action chunks.

nodes.name: train_lora.sh
nodes.docString: Shell script that launches Pi0.5 LoRA fine-tuning. Sets PYTHONPATH (common/src, train/src, deploy/src, third_party/lerobot/src), enables PYTHONNOUSERSITE to prevent conda env shadowing, parses --config override, and invokes `python -m pi05.train.cli.train --config <path>`. Passes extra positional args through to the training CLI.

properties.description: Two CLI entry points (train and export_bundle) both following the same pattern: argparse -> load_experiment_config -> bootstrap_project_paths -> call engine function. Both invoked via python -m from shell scripts.

End-to-end training pipeline: CLI -> config -> dataloader (Pi05LeRobotDataset + normalizers) -> model (build_pi05_with_lora) -> optimizer/scheduler -> Accelerate prepare -> train loop -> checkpoint -> final adapter -> deploy bundle export.

Training dataset extracts chunk_size-length action sequences (default 30). The chunk is padded at episode boundaries by repeating the last valid action. This is the train-side counterpart of the deploy-side chunked prediction.

The official PI0.5 preprocessor expects: observation.state (B, state_dim), action (B, chunk_size, action_dim), observation.images.<camera> (B, C, H, W), task (list[str]). The to_lerobot_pi05_batch adapter maps local keys to this schema.

Pi05LoraTrainer optionally auto-launches TensorBoard via launch_tensorboard() which: (1) checks for existing TensorBoard on the same logdir to reuse, (2) detects port conflicts and finds alternatives, (3) falls back from tensorboard binary to python -m tensorboard.main.
